constraints.description: Draw on the canvas over the dots.
Draw each line without lifting your finger or pen.

instructions:
1. The canvas shows the 41 dots of the target [CLM-01]. Draw on the canvas; the dots stay where they are.
2. The target is 1 continuous line with no loose ends [CLM-02, CLM-05]; try to draw each without lifting.
3. Pass through every dot the target line passes through, and keep dots the line leaves free untouched [CLM-04].
4. Stage 1 of 8 (a suggested order, not necessarily the original): without lifting, draw from (49% across, 7% down) to (18% across, 82% down), passing through 6 dots [CLM-06].
5. Stage 2 of 8 (a suggested order, not necessarily the original): without lifting, draw from (18% across, 82% down) to (94% across, 51% down), passing through 6 dots [CLM-07].
6. Stage 3 of 8 (a suggested order, not necessarily the original): without lifting, draw from (94% across, 51% down) to (18% across, 20% down), passing through 6 dots [CLM-08].
7. Stage 4 of 8 (a suggested order, not necessarily the original): without lifting, draw from (18% across, 20% down) to (49% across, 95% down), passing through 6 dots [CLM-09].
8. Stage 5 of 8 (a suggested order, not necessarily the original): without lifting, draw from (49% across, 95% down) to (81% across, 20% down), passing through 6 dots [CLM-10].
9. Stage 6 of 8 (a suggested order, not necessarily the original): without lifting, draw from (81% across, 20% down) to (5% across, 51% down), passing through 6 dots [CLM-11].
10. Stage 7 of 8 (a suggested order, not necessarily the original): without lifting, draw from (5% across, 51% down) to (81% across, 82% down), passing through 6 dots [CLM-12].
11. Stage 8 of 8 (a suggested order, not necessarily the original): without lifting, draw from (81% across, 82% down) to (49% across, 7% down), passing through 6 dots [CLM-13].
12. Check the finished drawing against the 8-fold symmetry of the target [CLM-03].
title: Draw the kolam on the dot grid
